Use a list for a single item or for laying out unrelated content; lists imply a meaningful collection.

Use a list for a single item or for laying out unrelated content; lists imply a meaningful collection.
Mix clickable and non-clickable items in the same list without clear visual distinction.

props.name: label
props.description: Primary content. A plain string gets single-line truncation automatically; a ReactNode renders as given, so child components control their own text behavior.

props.name: description
props.description: Secondary content below the label. A plain string gets single-line truncation automatically; a ReactNode lets child components control their own wrapping and line-clamp behavior.

props.name: startContent
props.description: Content rendered before the label area (e.g. icon, avatar).

props.name: endContent
props.description: Content rendered after the label area (e.g. badge, chevron).

props.name: onClick
props.description: Click handler; enables the invisible button pattern.

props.name: interactiveRef
props.description: Ref to a nested control (e.g. a checkbox in startContent) that owns the item's keyboard access and action. The row becomes an enlarged click/tap target that delegates surface clicks to it (useClickableContainer) and renders no invisible button/anchor, so the row adds no second tab stop (WCAG 4.1.2). Mutually exclusive with onClick/href; those are ignored when set.

props.name: href
props.description: Link URL; enables the invisible anchor pattern. The destination follows the shared navigation rule described on the Link `href` prop.

props.name: target
props.description: Link target attribute, only applicable when href is provided. target="_blank" automatically adds noopener noreferrer.

props.name: rel
props.description: Link relationship tokens. noopener noreferrer are merged automatically for target="_blank".

props.name: align
props.description: Vertical alignment of the start and end content against the label, passed through to Item unchanged. `first-line` keeps a small mark (a status dot, an icon) level with the first line of a wrapped label. See Item.align.

props.name: isDisabled
props.description: Disabled state; sets aria-disabled on the item.

props.name: isSelected
props.description: Selected state; marks the item as the current one with aria-current="true" (a list item cannot carry aria-selected).

props.name: itemKey
props.description: The row's item key, a string or a number from the data (the shape Table's idKey returns). It is the row's identity for the list's animated layout (List animatedLayout): with a handle, the list matches rows by it to animate inserts, removals and moves, and a row without one changes at once. In a reorderable List (List reorderable), it is the key the reorderable object's onReorder reports and isReorderable is asked about, and a row without one has no reorder handle and keeps its place. Separate from React's key.

props.name: swipeActions
props.description: Swipe actions for touch, passed through to Item unchanged: the verbs a sideways drag uncovers on each side, each `{id?, label, icon?, onActivate, isDisabled?, variant?: 'neutral' | 'accent' | 'destructive', hasRemoval?}`. See Item.swipeActions; List clips its rows in the inline axis for them.

props.name: swipeBehavior
props.description: What a swipe does, passed through to Item unchanged. See Item.swipeBehavior.

props.description: 主要内容。纯字符串会自动应用单行截断；ReactNode 按原样渲染，由子组件自行控制文本行为。

props.description: 在标签区域之前渲染的内容（如图标、头像）。

props.name: endContent
props.description: 在标签区域之后渲染的内容（如徽章、箭头）。

props.name: onClick
props.description: 点击处理函数；启用隐形按钮模式。

props.name: interactiveRef
props.description: 指向嵌套控件（如 startContent 中的复选框）的 ref，该控件承载项目的键盘访问和操作。行成为更大的点击/触摸目标，将表面点击委托给该控件（useClickableContainer），且不渲染不可见按钮/锚点，因此行不会增加第二个 Tab 停留点（WCAG 4.1.2）。与 onClick/href 互斥——设置后二者将被忽略。

props.name: href
props.description: 链接 URL；启用隐形锚点模式。

props.name: target
props.description: 链接 target 属性，仅在提供 href 时适用。target="_blank" 会自动添加 noopener noreferrer。

props.name: rel
props.description: 链接关系标记。target="_blank" 会自动合并 noopener noreferrer。

props.name: align
props.description: 起始和结束内容相对于标签的垂直对齐方式，原样传递给 Item。`first-line` 让小标记（状态点、图标）与换行标签的第一行保持水平。参见 Item.align。

props.name: isDisabled
props.description: 禁用状态；在项目上设置 aria-disabled。

props.name: isSelected
props.description: 选中状态；在项目上设置 aria-current="true"，将其标为当前项（列表项不能使用 aria-selected）。

props.name: itemKey
props.description: 行的项目键，取自数据的字符串或数字（与 Table 的 idKey 返回的形状相同）。它是列表动画布局（List animatedLayout）中该行的身份：传入句柄时，列表按它匹配各行，为插入、删除和移动添加动画；没有项目键的行会立即变化。在可重新排序的 List（List reorderable）中，它是可重新排序对象的 onReorder 报告的键，也是 isReorderable 判断的键；没有项目键的行没有重新排序手柄，保持原位。与 React 的 key 相互独立。

props.name: swipeActions
props.description: 触摸滑动操作，原样传递给 Item：横向拖动在每一侧揭示的操作，每项为 `{id?, label, icon?, onActivate, isDisabled?, variant?: 'neutral' | 'accent' | 'destructive', hasRemoval?}`。参见 Item.swipeActions；List 会在行内轴上裁剪行。

props.name: swipeBehavior
props.description: 滑动的行为，原样传递给 Item。参见 Item.swipeBehavior。

props.name: children
props.description: The markdown string to render.

props.name: display
props.description: Display type. Markdown defaults to block. Use 'inline' for markdown spans embedded inside text.

props.name: density
props.description: Controls spacing between block-level elements.

props.name: headingLevelStart
props.description: The HTML heading level that markdown # maps to. Shifts all heading levels down to fit the surrounding page hierarchy. Levels exceeding h6 are clamped to h6.

props.name: isStreaming
props.description: Enables streaming mode; it uses incremental parsing and a smooth fade-in animation for chunk-by-chunk text delivery.

props.name: onLinkClick
props.description: Handler for link clicks. Return false to prevent the default navigation behavior. Link destinations in the markdown follow the shared navigation rule described on the Link `href` prop: a blocked destination renders as plain text and never reaches this handler or a custom link renderer. Image URLs use a separate, stricter policy (every data: URL is rejected).

props.name: sources
props.description: Citation sources keyed by ID. When provided, [id] and 【id】 markers in the markdown that match a key are rendered as citation chips.

props.name: citationStyle
props.description: How citations are displayed inline. 'label' shows a chip with source title, icon, and border. 'number' shows a compact numbered badge.

props.name: contentWidth
props.description: Max width for prose content (paragraphs, headings, lists, blockquotes). Tables and code blocks are unconstrained and can expand to the full container width. Use for readable line lengths in wide layouts.

props.name: contentAlign
props.description: Alignment of prose content within the container when contentWidth is narrower than the available space.

props.name: plugins
props.description: Ordered extensions created by createMarkdownPlugin(). Plugins may add bounded syntax, immutable typed AST transforms, and typed extension renderers. Use isMarkdownExtensionNode() to narrow extension data observed from other plugins. Renderer callbacks are pure; return a child component when hooks are needed. Omitted and empty lists preserve the released Markdown behavior.

props.name: inlinePlugins
props.description: Transforms regex matches in parsed text nodes into custom inline React elements. Use for prefixed identifiers, mentions, and other shorthand patterns. Inline code, fenced code blocks, and math are unaffected.

props.name: autolink
props.description: Opt-in autolinking of bare URLs and emails. 'gfm' applies GitHub-Flavored Markdown autolink-literal rules: bare https?://..., www...., <scheme:url>, <email>, and user@host all become links. Trailing sentence punctuation and unbalanced trailing close-parens are excluded; matches inside code spans, code blocks, existing links, and image alt text are skipped. Default behavior (option unset) is unchanged.

props.name: codeLanguages
props.description: CodeBlock language values a fence may name, each imported on its own (e.g. graphql from @astryxdesign/core/CodeBlock/languages/graphql) or made with createCodeLanguage. A fence whose language word is one of a listed value's identifiers renders with it, ahead of a built-in; a diff-<identifier> fence takes the diff layer over it; a later entry wins. Pass the same list to RichTextEditor or RichTextView so read and edit match.

props.name: components
props.description: Custom React component overrides for rendered Markdown elements (code, inlineCode, math, link, heading, paragraph, image, blockquote, hr, citation). Providing math enables `$…$` inline and `$$…$$` display parsing and receives `{value, display}`; omit it when dollar text should stay literal.

props.name: xstyle
props.description: StyleX styles for layout customization (margins, positioning, sizing). Must be a stylex.create() value, not an inline style object like style={{}}.

props.name: className
props.description: CSS class name for the root element. Prefer xstyle for styling; className is provided for integration with non-StyleX systems.

props.name: style
props.description: Inline styles for the root element. Prefer xstyle for styling; inline styles bypass StyleX optimization.

props.name: data-testid
props.description: Test selector for automated testing frameworks.

defaults.children:
## Getting Started

Install the package:

```bash
npm install @astryxdesign/core
```

Then import and use any component:

```tsx
import {Button} from '@astryxdesign/core/Button';
```

**Bold**, *italic*, and `inline code` all work.

anatomy.description: Root container for block or inline Markdown content.

anatomy.name: Heading
anatomy.description: Rendered semantic heading block; a custom heading renderer replaces the built-in part.

anatomy.name: Paragraph
anatomy.description: Rendered paragraph block; a custom paragraph renderer replaces the default part.

anatomy.name: List
anatomy.description: Ordered, unordered, or task-list block rendered from Markdown items.

anatomy.name: Code block
anatomy.description: Fenced code block; long lines wrap rather than scroll sideways. A custom code renderer replaces the default part.

anatomy.name: Blockquote
anatomy.description: Quoted block; a custom blockquote renderer replaces the default part.

anatomy.name: Table
anatomy.description: Table block rendered from Markdown rows and columns; its Table child owns horizontal scrolling.

anatomy.name: Divider

usage.description: Renders a markdown string as Astryx-styled components. Use Markdown for user-generated content, AI responses, and documentation; it handles headings, lists, tables, code blocks, and citations with consistent styling.

bestPractices.description: Set headingLevelStart to match the page hierarchy, e.g. start at 3 if the markdown sits inside an h2 section.
Use contentWidth to keep prose at a readable line length in wide layouts.

Emphasis and strong pair as CommonMark specifies, so *see **bold** more* puts the bold inside the emphasis. ***text*** renders as strong around emphasis, the order RichText draws, and is announced as both. Emphasis nested more than 100 levels deep stays as written text.
Use plugins created by createMarkdownPlugin for reusable syntax, immutable AST transforms, and typed extension rendering. Keep the ordered list stable while its syntax configuration is unchanged.

To render a plugin node outside Markdown, as another surface showing the same document does, read what the plugin declares with getMarkdownPluginCapabilities (syntax and transform, nothing else), and render each parsed extension node with MarkdownPluginNodeRenderer from the client-only @astryxdesign/core/Markdown/plugin-renderer subpath. It presents the node exactly as Markdown does, fallbacks and failure reports included, with no element of its own.

Add markdownSoftBreaksPlugin when single line endings are meaningful. It matches remark-breaks for supported Markdown, including multiline link labels, while code and other opaque content stay unchanged.

Add markdownSourceLinesPlugin when a feature maps the rendered document back to Markdown source lines (find, highlights, review comments). Every block Markdown renders, nested blocks included, then carries data-source-line and data-source-line-end (1-based, inclusive); components block renderers receive sourceLines to place on their own element, and plugin renderers read node.position lines. Inline elements, table rows, and cells carry none. Without the plugin no line work runs.

Use createMarkdownTextTransform for prose matching; it preserves code, links, images, citations, math, and accepted extension syntax as protected contexts. Provide requiredSubstrings only when they conservatively cover every possible match.

Use createMarkdownFenceTransform for declared code-fence languages with semantic data. createNode returns an owned block extension node; its standard plugin renderer and toText own presentation. A claimed fence renders through that plugin even when components.code is supplied; components.code renders every unclaimed fence and is the fallback when the plugin renderer declines, throws, or suspends, and without it the accessible, copyable CodeBlock is that fallback.

Use createMarkdownSourceDecoration to attach non-visual metadata — search hits, review annotations — to the blocks a source range touches, and getMarkdownSourceDecorations to read it back in a later plugin. Decorations appear on the settled document rather than on partial streaming chunks, and never change rendering, copyable text, accessible names, ids, focus order, or navigation.

Import parseMarkdownAst or parseInlineAst from @astryxdesign/core/Markdown/parser when server or React Server Component code needs to run plugins against the canonical readonly tree. The parser and plugin subpaths have no use-client boundary. The Markdown component remains client-owned, so function-bearing plugin entries must not be passed across an RSC serialization boundary.

Use decodeMarkdownCharacterReferences (from @astryxdesign/core/Markdown/parser or @astryxdesign/core/Markdown) to show text the way Markdown renders its character references: ©, ©, and © become ©, while unknown names and references without their semicolon stay as written. It decodes plain text and knows nothing of Markdown, so skip code and backslash-escaped references yourself. It uses the same table Markdown renders with.

Use createMarkdownFrontmatter for typed document metadata. Its parse() method gives the host metadata directly; its plugin removes a complete leading block before rendering and withholds an unfinished block during streaming.

Import createMarkdownRemarkTransform from '@astryxdesign/core/Markdown/remark' only to reuse an existing synchronous transform-only Remark plugin; it stays out of every other bundle. Prove each plugin with fixtures: anything outside the supported MDAST subset — async work, parser or compiler plugins, processor state, raw HTML, unsupported nodes, forged positions, or metadata Astryx cannot represent — keeps the last valid document and reports one diagnostic.
Use inlinePlugins for prefixed identifiers, mentions, and other prose-only shorthand instead of preprocessing the markdown string.
Provide components.math only for documents that use dollar-delimited math. The renderer owns typesetting and accessible output; Astryx passes the expression as text and never executes raw HTML.

For direct parsing, use MathParseOptions and handle InlineNodeWithMath or BlockNodeWithMath. Incremental math parsing also uses createIncrementalState<true>() and IncrementalParseState<true>; default calls and ParseOptions annotations keep the legacy unions.

Install createMarkdownHeadingLinks() through plugins when a document needs copyable h1–h6 permalinks. The returned entry carries its validated namespace and URL base across compatible Core package copies. Each built-in heading keeps its incoming fragment ID and gains an inline trailing # copy button: it is hidden at fine-pointer rest through useContainerReveal, reveals on heading-row hover or keyboard focus, and stays visible under the hook’s coarse/touch semantics. Unmodified tap, click, Enter, or Space copies the canonical URL without navigation, hash mutation, or scrolling; a check confirms success for 1.5 seconds. The no-plugin path stays unchanged, and nested headings use the same depth-first identity projection as Markdown-derived Outline.

For multiple documents, create one heading-links plugin per document with headingIdPrefix and pass that same plugin to Markdown and useOutlineFromMarkdown. Use the same stable value for Markdown id when the root also needs a DOM id; permalinkBaseUrl may supply a safe caller-owned URL before the fragment.
Use Markdown for hand-authored layouts; use Text and Heading directly when you control the content.

propDescriptions.headingLevelStart: Maps # to this heading level (1-6). Clamped to h6. Default: 1.
propDescriptions.isStreaming: Incremental parse + fade-in for streamed chunks. Default: false.
propDescriptions.onLinkClick: (href, event) => void|false. Return false prevents navigation. Link destinations follow the shared navigation rule (see Link href); blocked ones render as text. Image URLs: separate stricter policy.
propDescriptions.sources: Record<string, MarkdownSource>. Citation sources by ID. [id]/【id】 markers render as chips.
propDescriptions.citationStyle: 'label'|'number'. label=chip w/ title+icon, number=compact badge. Default: 'label'.
propDescriptions.contentWidth: number|string. Max width for prose (headings, paragraphs, lists). Tables/code unconstrained.
propDescriptions.contentAlign: 'start'|'center'. Prose alignment when contentWidth < container. Default: 'start'.
propDescriptions.plugins: readonly MarkdownPluginEntry[]. Ordered syntax, immutable AST transforms, and typed extension renderers from createMarkdownPlugin(), plus first-party helpers such as createMarkdownHeadingLinks(). Default: omitted or empty.
propDescriptions.inlinePlugins: MarkdownInlinePlugin[]. Regex matches in text nodes -> custom inline React elements. Skips inline/fenced code and math.
propDescriptions.autolink: 'gfm'. Opt-in GFM autolinking: bare URLs (https?://, www.), <scheme:url>, <email>, user@host. Skips code, code blocks, existing links. Default: off.
propDescriptions.components: MarkdownComponents. Custom renderers; math({value, display}) opts into $…$/$$…$$ parsing. Renderer owns output and accessibility.
propDescriptions.xstyle: stylex.create() for layout (margins, sizing).

props.name: density
props.description: 控制块级元素之间的间距。

props.name: isStreaming
props.description: 启用流式模式，使用增量解析和淡入动画处理分块文本。

props.name: onLinkClick
props.description: 链接点击处理器。返回 false 可阻止默认导航行为。

props.name: sources
props.description: 按 ID 索引的引用来源。提供后，Markdown 中匹配的 [id] 和 【id】 标记将渲染为引用标签。

props.name: citationStyle
props.description: 引用的内联显示方式。'label' 显示带标题、图标和边框的标签。'number' 显示紧凑编号徽章。

props.name: contentWidth

props.name: contentAlign

usage.description: Renders a markdown string as Astryx-styled components. Use Markdown for user-generated content, AI responses, and documentation; it handles headings, lists, tables, code blocks, and citations with consistent styling.

bestPractices.description: Set headingLevelStart to match the page hierarchy, e.g. start at 3 if the markdown sits inside an h2 section.
Use contentWidth to keep prose at a readable line length in wide layouts.

Emphasis and strong pair as CommonMark specifies, so *see **bold** more* puts the bold inside the emphasis. ***text*** renders as strong around emphasis, the order RichText draws, and is announced as both. Emphasis nested more than 100 levels deep stays as written text.
Use plugins created by createMarkdownPlugin for reusable syntax, immutable AST transforms, and typed extension rendering. Keep the ordered list stable while its syntax configuration is unchanged.

To render a plugin node outside Markdown, as another surface showing the same document does, read what the plugin declares with getMarkdownPluginCapabilities (syntax and transform, nothing else), and render each parsed extension node with MarkdownPluginNodeRenderer from the client-only @astryxdesign/core/Markdown/plugin-renderer subpath. It presents the node exactly as Markdown does, fallbacks and failure reports included, with no element of its own.

Add markdownSoftBreaksPlugin when single line endings are meaningful. It matches remark-breaks for supported Markdown, including multiline link labels, while code and other opaque content stay unchanged.

Add markdownSourceLinesPlugin when a feature maps the rendered document back to Markdown source lines (find, highlights, review comments). Every block Markdown renders, nested blocks included, then carries data-source-line and data-source-line-end (1-based, inclusive); components block renderers receive sourceLines to place on their own element, and plugin renderers read node.position lines. Inline elements, table rows, and cells carry none. Without the plugin no line work runs.

Use createMarkdownTextTransform for prose matching; it preserves code, links, images, citations, math, and accepted extension syntax as protected contexts. Provide requiredSubstrings only when they conservatively cover every possible match.

Use createMarkdownFenceTransform for declared code-fence languages with semantic data. createNode returns an owned block extension node; its standard plugin renderer and toText own presentation. A claimed fence renders through that plugin even when components.code is supplied; components.code renders every unclaimed fence and is the fallback when the plugin renderer declines, throws, or suspends, and without it the accessible, copyable CodeBlock is that fallback.

Use createMarkdownSourceDecoration to attach non-visual metadata — search hits, review annotations — to the blocks a source range touches, and getMarkdownSourceDecorations to read it back in a later plugin. Decorations appear on the settled document rather than on partial streaming chunks, and never change rendering, copyable text, accessible names, ids, focus order, or navigation.

Import parseMarkdownAst or parseInlineAst from @astryxdesign/core/Markdown/parser when server or React Server Component code needs to run plugins against the canonical readonly tree. The parser and plugin subpaths have no use-client boundary. The Markdown component remains client-owned, so function-bearing plugin entries must not be passed across an RSC serialization boundary.

Use createMarkdownFrontmatter for typed document metadata. Its parse() method gives the host metadata directly; its plugin removes a complete leading block before rendering and withholds an unfinished block during streaming.

Import createMarkdownRemarkTransform from '@astryxdesign/core/Markdown/remark' only to reuse an existing synchronous transform-only Remark plugin; it stays out of every other bundle. Prove each plugin with fixtures: anything outside the supported MDAST subset — async work, parser or compiler plugins, processor state, raw HTML, unsupported nodes, forged positions, or metadata Astryx cannot represent — keeps the last valid document and reports one diagnostic.
Use inlinePlugins for prefixed identifiers, mentions, and other prose-only shorthand instead of preprocessing the markdown string.
Provide components.math only for documents that use dollar-delimited math. The renderer owns typesetting and accessible output; Astryx passes the expression as text and never executes raw HTML.

For direct parsing, use MathParseOptions and handle InlineNodeWithMath or BlockNodeWithMath. Incremental math parsing also uses createIncrementalState<true>() and IncrementalParseState<true>; default calls and ParseOptions annotations keep the legacy unions.

Install createMarkdownHeadingLinks() through plugins when a document needs copyable h1–h6 permalinks. The returned entry carries its validated namespace and URL base across compatible Core package copies. Each built-in heading keeps its incoming fragment ID and gains an inline trailing # copy button: it is hidden at fine-pointer rest through useContainerReveal, reveals on heading-row hover or keyboard focus, and stays visible under the hook’s coarse/touch semantics. Unmodified tap, click, Enter, or Space copies the canonical URL without navigation, hash mutation, or scrolling; a check confirms success for 1.5 seconds. The no-plugin path stays unchanged, and nested headings use the same depth-first identity projection as Markdown-derived Outline.

For multiple documents, create one heading-links plugin per document with headingIdPrefix and pass that same plugin to Markdown and useOutlineFromMarkdown. Use the same stable value for Markdown id when the root also needs a DOM id; permalinkBaseUrl may supply a safe caller-owned URL before the fragment.
Use Markdown for hand-authored layouts; use Text and Heading directly when you control the content.

components.name: MobileNav
components.description: A slide-out drawer for mobile navigation. Accepts SideNav children.

props.name: isOpen
props.description: Whether the drawer is open. Inside AppShell, this is managed automatically via context. Outside AppShell, provide this prop to control the drawer yourself.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called when the drawer visibility changes (backdrop click, Escape key, or close button). Inside AppShell, this is managed automatically via context. On a phone or tablet (a coarse primary pointer), the drawer takes no tap or drag while it slides in; keys and assistive technology still act. After a close, focus returns to the element that opened it once its dialog closes.

props.name: children
props.description: Drawer content: typically SideNavSection/SideNavItem, or any ReactNode.

props.name: header
props.description: Header content for the drawer. Rendered next to the close button. Pass a string for a simple text heading, or a ReactNode for custom content (logo, search bar, etc.).

props.name: width
props.description: Drawer width in pixels. Capped at 85vw to prevent overflow on small screens.

props.name: side
props.description: Which side the drawer slides from. Start is left in LTR, right in RTL. Auto picks a side based on the trigger position.

components.name: MobileNavToggle
components.description: Hamburger button that opens/closes the mobile nav drawer. Reads open state from AppShell context automatically: does NOT accept isOpen or onOpenChange props. Renders nothing above the mobile breakpoint. Host attributes and DOM handlers (id, data-*, aria-*) reach the button; its aria-expanded and aria-controls stay component-owned, and a caller onClick runs after the toggle.

props.name: children
props.description: Custom content to render instead of the default hamburger icon.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible label for the toggle button.

props.description: 菜单呈现策略。`adaptive` 在指针布局中使用锚定浮层，在主指针为粗略指针且视口宽度小于主题的 `md` 断点（默认 768px）或高度小于 500px 时使用 BottomSheet。省略时，菜单为锚定浮层；在任何设备上用手指操作时，打开菜单的手指移动 10 px 后才会选择菜单项。传入 'popover' 可在所有设备上保持指针行为，包括稳定规则。

props.name: xstyle
props.description: 用于布局自定义的 StyleX 样式（边距、定位、尺寸）。必须是 stylex.create() 的值，不能是内联样式对象如 style={{}}。

usage.description: MoreMenu is a three-dot button that opens a list of actions. Use it for secondary actions that don't need to be always visible, like in table rows, card headers, or toolbars.

bestPractices.description: Use for overflow or secondary actions; keep primary actions visible outside the menu.
Use dividers or sections to group related actions when the menu has many items.
Use `presentation="adaptive"` when the visible overflow trigger should open a thumb-reachable BottomSheet on compact touch devices.
Hide primary actions inside a MoreMenu; they should be directly visible.

components.name: MultiSelector
components.description: Multi-select dropdown with checkboxes for choosing multiple items.

props.name: label
props.description: Label text for accessibility.

props.name: options
props.description: Array of items: strings, objects with value/label/icon/disabled, dividers, or sections. An option may carry `action`: one node — an IconButton, a Button, a menu trigger — the caller renders and names. Once any option does, the popup is a grid whose rows pair the option with its action: Up/Down move rows, the inline-end arrow reaches the action, Enter fires it, pointer and touch press it directly, and pressing it never changes the selection.

props.name: value
props.description: Currently selected values.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called when the selection changes. A creation (hasCreate) arrives with `{type: "create", query}` as the second argument and the query appended to value; the caller adds the matching option in that same update. Every other change passes no descriptor, so a one-argument handler keeps working.

props.name: changeAction
props.description: Async action on change. Fires after onChange.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Placeholder text shown when no value is selected.

props.name: size
props.description: Size variant for the selector.

props.name: variant
props.description: Visual trigger style. input is the bordered input treatment for forms; secondary matches the secondary buttons of the active theme (borderless and neutral-filled by default) for navs and toolbars; ghost is borderless and transparent, matching ghost buttons for toolbar usage.

props.name: triggerDisplay
props.description: How to display selected items in the trigger.

props.name: formatValue
props.description: Formats the trigger text when triggerDisplay="count" or "labels". Receives the selected items (value plus resolved label); the count is items.length. Not used by triggerDisplay="badges".

props.name: maxBadges
props.description: Maximum badges to show before "+N". Only for triggerDisplay="badges".

props.name: hasSelectAll
props.description: Whether to show a select-all checkbox.

props.name: selectAllLabel
props.description: Label for the select-all checkbox.

props.name: hasSearch
props.description: Whether to show a search input for filtering options. As the user types, the match count (or "No results found") is announced to screen readers via a polite live region. The search field has built-in affordances: a leading magnifier icon and, once a query is typed, a trailing clear (✕) button that resets the query and returns focus to the input.

props.name: searchPlaceholder
props.description: Placeholder text for the search input.

props.name: emptyText
props.description: Content shown in the dropdown panel when there are no options to show, and announced in a polite live region when the panel opens. The announcement is the text this content renders, read from the DOM, so an element is announced as written and aria-hidden parts are left out of both. Not shown while isLoading.

props.name: emptySearchText
props.description: Content shown in the dropdown panel when a search query matches no options, and announced in a polite live region at the same time. The announcement is the text this content renders, read from the DOM, so an element is announced as written and aria-hidden parts are left out of both.

props.name: hasCreate
props.description: With hasSearch, offers a `Create "<query>"` row first in the list when the typed text equals no option label under the search’s case-insensitive matching. Picking it, or Enter with nothing highlighted, calls onChange with the query appended to value and a `{type: "create", query}` descriptor, then clears the search; the caller must add an option for the new value in that update. Nothing is offered while isLoading. Without hasSearch it warns in development and offers nothing.

props.name: isDisabled
props.description: Disables the selector.

props.name: isReadOnly
props.description: Makes the selector read-only: the selected values stay visible, focusable, and included in form submission, and retain their combobox identity with aria-readonly. The selection surface, clear action, and disclosure indicator are removed. Unlike isDisabled, the control is not dimmed. isDisabled takes precedence when both are set.

props.name: htmlName
props.description: The HTML name attribute for form submissions. Renders one hidden input per selected value, like a native multi-select.

props.name: disabledMessage
props.description: Explains why the selector is disabled. With isDisabled, shows the reason as a tooltip on hover and keyboard focus of the trigger, which stays focusable (aria-disabled) like every disabled selector; activation stays blocked. Use this instead of wrapping a disabled MultiSelector in Tooltip.

props.name: isLabelHidden
props.description: Visually hides the label while keeping it accessible.

props.name: description
props.description: Helper text displayed below the label.

props.name: isOptional
props.description: Marks the field as optional.

props.name: isRequired
props.description: Marks the field as required.

props.name: isLoading
props.description: Shows a loading spinner in the trigger.

props.name: status
props.description: Validation status with an optional message.

props.name: statusVariant
props.description: How the status message is placed relative to the input. attached overlaps directly below the bordered input and is only valid for the input variant; secondary and ghost selectors detach attached status messages by default. Use tooltip for compact toolbar controls.
props.default: 'attached' for input selectors; 'detached' for secondary and ghost selectors

props.name: renderOption
props.description: Custom render function for each selectable option in the dropdown. Not called for dividers, sections, or the select-all row.

props.name: indicatorPosition
props.description: Which edge of the option row carries the checkbox. end pushes it to the far edge of the row, including on the select-all row.

props.name: presentation
props.description: How the option list is presented. adaptive uses a bottom sheet on compact touch screens and an anchored popover otherwise.

props.name: width
props.description: Width of the field (number = pixels, string used as-is, e.g. "100%"). Sizes the whole field (label, control, and status) so they stay aligned.

props.name: startIcon
props.description: Icon displayed at the start of the selector trigger.

props.name: hasClear
props.description: Shows a clear button when values are selected.

props.name: isDefaultOpen
props.description: Whether the dropdown starts open on mount.

props.name: renderTrigger
props.description: Render the control the panel hangs off — a glyph in a list row, a chip, an icon button — instead of the selector's own field and button. Spread the given props ({ref, id, onClick, onKeyDown, onFocus, aria-haspopup, aria-expanded, aria-controls, aria-busy}) onto it; the listbox is anchored to that control and named by `label`. The field chrome (Field, status, clear, spinner) is not rendered. Pair with handleRef to open from a keystroke elsewhere.

props.name: handleRef
props.description: Imperative handle with open(), close(), toggle() and isOpen(). Prefer it over mirroring open state in the parent; the selector owns its visibility.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called whenever the panel opens or closes, however it happened: the trigger, the keyboard, a light dismiss, Escape, or the handle.

props.name: onClick
props.description: Click handler on the trigger (or the renderTrigger control). Runs after the built-in toggle and cannot cancel it.

props.name: onFocus
props.description: Focus handler on the trigger. Runs before the selector's own focus handling.

props.name: onKeyDown
props.description: Key handler on the trigger button. Runs after the built-in keyboard model and is skipped for keys it handles and cancels.

props.name: containerXstyle
props.description: StyleX styles for the field container (label, control, and status together). No effect inside InputGroup (style the InputGroup instead) or in a `horizontal-labels` FormLayout. Root `xstyle`, `className`, and `style` are not accepted.

props.name: containerClassName
props.description: Class name for the field container. Same targeting as `containerXstyle`.

props.name: containerStyle
props.description: Inline styles for the field container. Same targeting as `containerXstyle`.

props.name: controlXstyle
props.description: StyleX styles for the visual control box: the element that paints the border and background and holds the value, icons, and end controls. Never the trigger button itself.

props.name: controlClassName
props.description: Class name for the visual control box.

props.name: controlStyle
props.description: Inline styles for the visual control box.

anatomy.name: Field
anatomy.description: Standalone Field shell that provides the label and optional supporting content; omitted inside InputGroup.

anatomy.name: Trigger
anatomy.description: Painted control that displays the current selection or placeholder and opens the selection surface when editable.

anatomy.name: Icon-rendered start icon
anatomy.description: Optional leading semantic icon or icon component rendered through Icon.

anatomy.name: Caller-rendered start content
anatomy.description: Optional arbitrary React content rendered directly at the start of the trigger.

anatomy.name: Trigger clear button
anatomy.description: Shared clear action that removes every selected value when hasClear is enabled.

anatomy.name: Status icon
anatomy.description: Status glyph shown in place of the disclosure indicator for attached or tooltip status.

anatomy.name: Indicator icon
anatomy.description: Trailing chevron shown when status presentation does not replace it; reflects collapsed or expanded state.

anatomy.name: Search row
anatomy.description: Panel header with a borderless search input and optional clear action.

anatomy.name: Search icon
anatomy.description: Leading magnifier rendered through Icon inside the search row.

anatomy.name: Search clear button
anatomy.description: Shared clear action shown in the search row while a query is present.

anatomy.name: Section heading
anatomy.description: Visible heading for a labeled group of option rows.

anatomy.name: Empty state
anatomy.description: Message shown when the shared panel content has no options or no search matches.

anatomy.name: Pointer popup
anatomy.description: Anchored painted surface that hosts the shared panel content for popover presentation.

anatomy.name: Touch sheet heading
anatomy.description: Heading above the shared panel content in bottom-sheet presentation.

anatomy.description: BottomSheet surface that hosts the same panel content for bottom-sheet presentation.

usage.description: A checkbox dropdown for selecting multiple values from a list. Selected items can display as a count, labels, or badges. Use it for filtering or when presenting a finite set of options where multiple choices are needed.

bestPractices.description: Use for a moderate, finite set of options where multiple choices are needed.
Enable search filtering when the list exceeds ~15 options.
Use renderOption for custom option rows; the checkbox affordance remains owned by MultiSelector.
Enable select-all when most users will want all or nearly all options selected.
Use inside InputGroup only when the control needs a short prefix or suffix addon as part of one decorated input surface; prefer count or labels trigger display so the group stays single-line.

Use variant="secondary" when a multi-selector sits beside secondary buttons or segmented controls, and variant="ghost" when it sits beside ghost buttons. If validation status is needed there, prefer statusVariant="tooltip" so the toolbar height stays compact.
Use presentation="adaptive" when the multi-selector should become a bottom sheet on compact touch screens.
Use for single-value selection; use Selector instead.
Show more than ~20 options without enabling search.
Wrap a disabled MultiSelector in Tooltip to explain why it is disabled. Use the disabledMessage prop, which attaches the reason to the trigger itself.

components.description: 带复选框的多选下拉框，用于从列表中选择多项。

propDescriptions.label: 无障碍标签文本。
propDescriptions.options: 项目数组——字符串、带 value/label/icon/disabled 的对象、分隔线或分组。
propDescriptions.onChange: 选择变化时触发的回调。
propDescriptions.changeAction: 变化时的异步操作，在 onChange 之后触发。
propDescriptions.placeholder: 未选择值时显示的占位文本。
propDescriptions.triggerDisplay: 在触发器中显示选中项的方式。
propDescriptions.formatValue: 格式化 triggerDisplay="count" 或 "labels" 时的触发器文本。接收选中项（value 及解析后的 label），数量为 items.length。triggerDisplay="badges" 不使用此属性。
propDescriptions.maxBadges: 显示"+N"之前的最大徽章数。仅适用于 triggerDisplay="badges"。
propDescriptions.hasSearch: 是否显示用于过滤选项的搜索输入。
propDescriptions.emptyText: 没有可显示的选项时，下拉面板中显示的内容。
propDescriptions.emptySearchText: 搜索查询未匹配到任何选项时，下拉面板中显示的内容。
propDescriptions.hasCreate: 配合 hasSearch：当输入的文本与任何选项标签都不匹配时，在列表首行提供“创建 "<query>"”行；选中后通过 onChange 以 {type: "create", query} 描述符报告，调用方需在同一次更新中添加该选项。
propDescriptions.isReadOnly: 将选择器设为只读：保留当前值、焦点顺序和表单提交，但移除选择面板、清除操作和展开指示器。与 isDisabled 不同，只读控件不会变暗；两者同时设置时 isDisabled 优先。
propDescriptions.htmlName: 用于表单提交的 HTML name 属性。为每个已选值渲染一个隐藏输入，类似原生多选。
propDescriptions.disabledMessage: 解释选择器被禁用的原因。与 isDisabled 一起使用时，悬停/键盘聚焦时显示工具提示，触发器与所有被禁用的选择器一样通过 aria-disabled 保持可聚焦（仍无法激活）。请使用此属性，而不是用 Tooltip 包裹被禁用的选择器。
propDescriptions.isLabelHidden: 视觉上隐藏标签同时保持其可访问性。
propDescriptions.description: 标签下方显示的辅助文本。
propDescriptions.isLoading: 在触发器中显示加载旋转器。
propDescriptions.status: 带可选消息的验证状态。
propDescriptions.statusVariant: 状态消息的放置方式：attached 直接叠加在输入框下方；detached 作为独立元素浮于下方并留有间距。
propDescriptions.renderOption: 每个可选选项的自定义渲染函数。不会用于分隔线、分组或全选行。
propDescriptions.renderTrigger: 由调用方渲染面板的触发控件（替代选择器自带的字段和按钮）；将传入的属性展开到该控件上，列表框将锚定于它并由 label 命名。
propDescriptions.onOpenChange: 面板每次打开或关闭时触发，无论由何种方式引起。
propDescriptions.presentation: 选项列表的呈现方式：锚定弹出框、底部抽屉，或根据紧凑触控屏自适应。
propDescriptions.onClick: 触发器的点击处理函数，在内置开关之后运行，无法取消它。
propDescriptions.onFocus: 触发器的焦点处理函数，在选择器自身的焦点处理之前运行。

params.name: options
params.description: Configuration object.

params.name: options.selectableItems
params.description: The options in the same order as they render. Options with `disabled` cannot be toggled and are skipped while moving through the open list. Opening never lands on a disabled option: ArrowUp opens on the last enabled option, and ArrowDown, a press, Enter or Space on the first enabled option.

params.name: options.isOpen
params.description: Whether the list is shown. The caller owns this state.

params.name: options.onOpen
params.description: Called to show the list. Return `false` to refuse; the hook then leaves the highlight alone.

params.name: options.onClose
params.description: Called to hide the list. The highlight resets first.

params.name: options.onToggle
params.description: Called with the value of the option to add or remove. Toggling keeps the list open.

params.name: options.listboxId
params.description: The listbox (or grid) element's id. Option and action-cell ids are derived from it.

params.name: options.hasSearch
params.description: Whether the list has its own search field. Space then types instead of toggling, opening by a press or Enter does not pre-highlight (ArrowDown and ArrowUp still open on the first and last enabled option), Delete and Backspace edit the query, and type-to-select is off. Home and End still jump to the first and last option, so a search input that keeps them for the caret should stop them before this handler and rely on PageUp and PageDown.

params.name: options.onClear
params.description: Clears every selected value. When provided, Delete or Backspace on the closed control clears them, so clearing is not pointer-only. Ignored while the list is open or with `hasSearch`.

params.name: options.hasValue
params.description: Whether anything is selected. The Delete and Backspace clear is skipped when false.

params.name: options.isGrid
params.description: Whether each row pairs an option cell with an action cell. The inline-end arrow then moves the highlight to the row's action and the inline-start arrow back, following visual direction in right-to-left layouts, and Enter on the action runs `onActivateAction` instead of toggling.

params.name: options.rowHasAction
params.description: In a grid, whether the row at `index` has an action cell to move to.

params.name: options.onActivateAction
params.description: In a grid, runs the control in the highlighted row's action cell. The selection does not change.

params.name: options.isDisabled
params.description: Whether the control ignores clicks and keys.

returns.name: highlightedIndex
returns.description: Index of the active row, or -1 when none is active.

returns.name: setHighlightedIndex
returns.description: Sets the active row, for example after filtering. The highlight lands on the row's option cell.

returns.name: highlightedCell
returns.description: Which cell of the active row is highlighted; `'action'` only in a grid.

returns.name: activeDescendantId
returns.description: The id to pass as the control's `aria-activedescendant`: the active option, or its action cell in a grid. Undefined while the list is closed or nothing is active.

returns.name: getItemId
returns.description: The id to render on the option at `index`.

returns.name: getActionCellId
returns.description: In a grid, the id to render on the action cell of row `index`.

returns.name: onTriggerClick
returns.description: Toggles the list from a press on the control.

returns.name: onKeyDown
returns.description: Key handler for the control that keeps focus. ArrowDown and ArrowUp open the list or move the active row; Enter (and Space without search) toggles the active option and keeps the list open; Escape and Tab close it; Home, End, PageUp and PageDown jump to the first or last option; without search, typed characters move to the next option whose label starts with them, as in Selector (a repeated letter cycles, and a single letter searches from the option after the active one), and Space still toggles.

returns.name: onItemMouseEnter
returns.description: Makes the hovered option, or its action cell, active without scrolling the list or moving focus.

usage.description: Tracks the active option of a multi-select combobox and handles its keys, while DOM focus stays on the control. It powers MultiSelector; unlike useCombobox, toggling an option keeps the list open, and rows can carry an action cell. It renders nothing and sets no attributes: the caller renders the control and the list, and wires the ARIA attributes from what it returns.

bestPractices.description: Render each option with `id={getItemId(index)}` and pass `activeDescendantId` as the control's `aria-activedescendant`.
Use `isGrid` only when rows carry a control next to the option; give each action cell `id={getActionCellId(index)}`.
Announce the number of results through useAnnounce when the options change for a new query.
Close the list after each toggle; a multi-select stays open so several options can be picked in a row.

docsDense.description: Multi-select combobox state + keys; focus stays on control. Powers MultiSelector. Toggle keeps list open; rows may carry an action cell (grid). Renders nothing, sets no attrs: caller renders + wires ARIA.

paramDescriptions.options.onClear: clear all; Delete / Backspace on closed control. ignored when open or hasSearch.
paramDescriptions.options.hasValue: anything selected; clear skipped when false.

components.name: Outline
components.description: Document outline navigation with sliding indicator track. Renders a flat heading list as anchor links with a density variant and scroll-spy active state when uncontrolled.

props.name: items
props.description: Ordered heading items. Each item has id, label, and level (1-6). The id should match the target heading element id.

props.name: activeId
props.description: Currently active heading id. Providing this prop makes active state controlled and disables built-in scroll-spy.

props.name: onActiveIdChange
props.description: Called when the active item changes from built-in scroll-spy or from an outline link click.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible label for the nav landmark.

props.name: density
props.description: Density variant controlling item padding. 'compact' for dense UIs, 'default' for standard spacing.

props.name: onNavigateStart
props.description: Called with the item id when navigation begins, before the scroll starts. Pair with onNavigateEnd to drive an arrival effect (flash, ring, pulse) on the target heading.

props.name: onNavigateEnd
props.description: Called with the item id once the navigation resolves - when the smooth scroll settles, or when reduced motion turns it into an instant jump. Fires exactly once per onNavigateStart, including when the user interrupts the scroll, so a "navigating" state can never leak.

props.name: offset
props.description: Height in px of a fixed header overlaying the top of the scroll root. Shifts both the activation line and the scroll landing by the same amount, so a heading activates exactly where navigating to it puts it - below the header, not underneath it. Composes with each heading's own scroll-margin-top (the header, then the breathing room below it); it does not replace it. Leave at 0 when nothing overlays the content and let scroll-margin-top do the work.

props.name: scrollContainerRef
props.description: Scroll container to track, instead of auto-detecting the nearest scrollable ancestor. Use it when content scrolls inside a split pane, modal, or dashboard panel rather than the viewport.

props.name: hasScrollOnClick
props.description: Whether activating an item smooth-scrolls to it. Set to false to own the scrolling yourself (virtualized content, a router): the Outline still updates the active item, the hash, and the navigate callbacks, but performs no scroll.

props.name: xstyle
props.description: StyleX styles for layout customization. Must be a stylex.create() value.

usage.description: A table-of-contents sidebar for documentation pages, help centers, wikis, and long settings pages. Use it for navigation within a single page, not for app routes. Features a sliding indicator track that animates to the active heading. Each link is in the normal Tab order, and Enter/Space activate.

bestPractices.description: Pass a flat ordered list of headings and let level control indentation.
Use activeId when custom scroll logic owns the active section.
Use density="compact" in dense sidebars where vertical space is tight.

Use useOutlineFromMarkdown or useOutlineFromDOM when headings are generated from content. For linkable Markdown headings, pass the same createMarkdownHeadingLinks() entry to Markdown and Outline; configure headingIdPrefix on that plugin for multiple roots.
Pass scrollContainerRef when the content scrolls in a split pane, modal, or panel instead of the viewport.
Set offset to the height of a fixed header that overlays the content, so headings land below it instead of underneath it.
Use Outline for application navigation - use SideNav or TopNav for routes.
Use Outline for expandable hierarchy - use TreeList when nodes need expand and collapse.
Rely on onNavigateEnd to mean "arrived" - it also fires when the user interrupts the scroll.

docsDense.description: Document outline/table-of-contents nav with sliding indicator track. Flat items array {id,label,level}; anchor links; density variant (default/compact); uncontrolled scroll-spy by scroll position (last heading past its resting line = offset + its own scroll-margin-top; first item at top, last at bottom); controlled with activeId; smooth-scroll on click that pins the active item until the next manual scroll. Each link is a Tab stop; Enter/Space activate; no arrow/Home/End movement. onNavigateStart/onNavigateEnd fire around the scroll. Scroll scoping via offset / scrollContainerRef / hasScrollOnClick.

components.name: Outline
components.description: 文档大纲导航，带有滑动指示器轨道。将扁平标题列表渲染为锚点链接，支持密度变体和非受控模式下的滚动监听。

props.name: items
props.description: 有序标题项。每项包含 id、label 和 level (1-6)。id 应匹配目标标题元素的 id。

props.name: activeId
props.description: 当前激活的标题 id。提供后组件进入受控模式，并禁用内置滚动监听。

props.name: onActiveIdChange
props.description: 当内置滚动监听或点击大纲链接改变激活项时调用。

props.name: label
props.description: nav 地标的无障碍标签。

props.name: density
props.description: 控制项目内边距的密度变体。'compact' 用于紧凑界面，'default' 为标准间距。

props.name: onNavigateStart
props.description: 导航开始时（滚动前）调用，传入项目 id。与 onNavigateEnd 搭配可在目标标题上实现到达效果（闪烁、描边、脉冲）。

props.name: onNavigateEnd
props.description: 导航结束时调用（平滑滚动停止，或减弱动效将其变为瞬时跳转）。每次 onNavigateStart 必定对应一次调用，包括用户中途手动滚动打断的情况，因此“导航中”状态不会泄漏。

props.name: offset
props.description: 覆盖滚动根顶部的固定顶栏高度（px）。同时位移激活线与滚动落点，因此标题被激活的位置正是点击后停留的位置——落在顶栏下方，而非被顶栏遮住。它与每个标题自身的 scroll-margin-top 叠加（先顶栏，再留白），而非取代它。若没有元素覆盖内容，保持 0，交给 scroll-margin-top 处理。

props.name: scrollContainerRef
props.description: 要跟踪的滚动容器，替代自动探测最近的可滚动祖先。当内容在分栏、弹窗或面板中滚动而非视口时使用。

props.name: hasScrollOnClick
props.description: 激活项目时是否平滑滚动。设为 false 可自行接管滚动（虚拟列表、路由）：Outline 仍会更新激活项、hash 和导航回调，但不执行滚动。

props.name: xstyle
props.description: 用于布局自定义的 StyleX 样式。必须是 stylex.create() 值。

usage.description: A table-of-contents sidebar for documentation pages, help centers, wikis, and long settings pages. Use it for navigation within a single page, not for app routes.

bestPractices.description: Pass a flat ordered list of headings and let level control indentation.
Use activeId when custom scroll logic owns the active section.
Use density="compact" in dense sidebars where vertical space is tight.

Use useOutlineFromMarkdown or useOutlineFromDOM when headings are generated from content. For linkable Markdown headings, pass the same createMarkdownHeadingLinks() entry to Markdown and Outline; configure headingIdPrefix on that plugin for multiple roots.
Use Outline for application navigation - use SideNav or TopNav for routes.
Use Outline for expandable hierarchy - use TreeList when nodes need expand and collapse.

params.name: markdown
params.description: The Markdown source. Pass the same string you render with Markdown.

params.name: options
params.description: Parse options. Omit them for a document that Markdown renders without plugins.

params.name: options.plugins
params.description: The ordered Markdown plugin list. Pass the same list to Markdown, so transforms, labels and ids agree. The outline is recomputed when the list reference changes.

params.name: options.isFinal
params.description: Whether the source is complete. Pass false while Markdown's isStreaming is true, so both apply the same transforms.

returns.name: items
returns.description: One item per root heading, in document order, ready for Outline's items prop. id is the id Markdown renders on the heading in a complete document without sources, label is the heading's text, and level is its depth from 1 to 6.

usage.description: Extracts the headings of a Markdown string for an Outline next to the rendered document. It uses the parser and heading slugs that Markdown uses, so in a complete document each item links to its heading, and fenced code never counts as a heading. The result is memoized on the source and the options. Outside React, use parseOutlineFromMarkdown.

bestPractices.description: Pass the same string, plugin list and finality to Markdown and this hook, so items match the rendered headings once the content is complete.
Declare the plugin list outside the component or memoize it. A new array on each render recomputes the outline.
For several documents on one page, install one createMarkdownHeadingLinks per document with headingIdPrefix, so their ids do not collide.
Write the items by hand or find headings with a regular expression. They drift from the rendered ids.
Expect every item to have a target while content streams. Markdown reveals text gradually and trims unfinished syntax, so a heading can be absent or have another id until the content is complete.

Expect an item to link to a heading that cites a Markdown sources entry. The hook does not receive sources, so the ids differ: for '# Intro [ref]', Markdown renders intro and the hook returns intro-ref.
Expect an item for a nested heading, such as one in a blockquote. Only root headings become items.

props.name: children
props.description: Items to render. Each child should be a single element.

props.name: overflowRenderer
props.description: Render function for the overflow indicator. Receives the list of hidden items (each with child and index). Only called when items are overflowing.

props.name: onOverflowChange
props.description: Called whenever the collapsed set changes: with the collapsed items once something collapses, and with an empty array once the row widens back out. Membership and order changes report even when the count stays the same; unrelated re-renders and callback identity changes do not. Silent while nothing overflows, including on mount. Use stable React keys for dynamic items.

props.name: gap
props.description: Gap between items as a spacing token step (0, 0.5, 1, 1.5, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 8, 10).

props.name: minVisibleItems
props.description: Minimum number of items to always show, even when overflowing.

props.name: maxVisibleItems
props.description: Maximum number of items to ever show, even when they all fit. The ceiling partner to minVisibleItems; extra items collapse into the overflow indicator. If less than minVisibleItems, the floor wins.

props.name: maxRows
props.description: Wrap items across up to this many rows before collapsing the rest into the overflow indicator. A number, not a boolean. Leave undefined (or set 1) for single-line behavior. Assumes uniform row height.

props.name: collapseFrom
props.description: Which end to collapse items from when overflow occurs.

props.name: behavior
props.description: Controls which element is measured for available width. 'observeSelf' uses the container's own width. 'observeParent' observes the parent element, useful when the list should stay content-sized while still detecting available space.

props.name: xstyle
props.description: StyleX styles for layout customization (margins, positioning, sizing). Must be a stylex.create() value, not an inline style object.

anatomy.name: List
anatomy.description: Visible horizontal list container for the currently shown content.

anatomy.name: Items
anatomy.description: Caller-supplied items selected for visible display by the current width and count limits.

anatomy.name: Overflow indicator
anatomy.description: Optional caller-rendered indicator for items collapsed by width or count limits.

usage.description: A horizontal list that automatically hides items when they exceed the available width. Use OverflowList for breadcrumbs, toolbars, tag lists, or any row that needs to collapse gracefully at smaller sizes.

bestPractices.description: Provide a meaningful overflowRenderer: a "+N more" badge, a dropdown, or a count indicator.
When the row already has its own menu, use onOverflowChange to feed the collapsed items into it instead of adding a second anchor with overflowRenderer.
Set minVisibleItems to keep key items visible, and maxVisibleItems to cap the row at a fixed count regardless of available width.
Use maxRows to let items wrap onto a bounded number of rows (e.g. a two-row tag cloud) before collapsing the rest into the indicator.
Use OverflowList for a vertical stack; horizontal multi-row wrap is supported via maxRows, but items still flow left-to-right, not top-to-bottom.

params.description: Overlay configuration. Every field is optional.

params.name: options.content
params.description: Content to render inside the scrim. When set, the hook returns it pre-rendered as element.

params.name: options.showOn
params.description: Visibility trigger, read with CSS from the container. 'hover' also reveals on focus within the container for keyboard users; 'hover-or-focus' is an alias for it. On a touch device (hover: none), a hover overlay toggles on a tap on the container instead.

params.name: options.isOpen
params.description: Controlled visibility. When set, it takes precedence over showOn and the touch toggle.

params.name: options.scrim
params.description: Scrim background. false renders the content with no scrim background.

params.name: options.position

params.name: options.align

returns.name: containerRef
returns.description: Attach to the container element.

returns.name: containerProps
returns.description: Spread on the same container: className and style mark it as the overlay scope (positioned, clipped), and on a touch device with a hover overlay onClick and onMouseUp toggle it on a tap.

returns.name: element
returns.description: The scrim with options.content, ready to render once inside the container. null when content is not set.

returns.name: renderOverlay
returns.description: Renders the scrim around the children you pass, for content that changes or a scrim you mount yourself. Use it or element, not both.

usage.description: Adds overlay behavior to a container you already render, such as a Card or a custom media frame, without the wrapper Overlay adds. Spread containerRef and containerProps on the container, then render element (or renderOverlay(children)) once inside it. The scrim is absolutely positioned, so it covers the nearest positioned ancestor: the container itself, or a positioned section inside it such as an image area. Visibility is CSS-driven from the container's :hover and :focus-within, so with showOn 'hover' a keyboard user reveals the content by moving focus into the container. Hidden content is not focusable, so the container needs a focusable element before the overlay content in tab order. A revealed scrim takes pointer input over the area it covers, so put that element outside the scrim, or use a top or bottom strip and keep it in the part the strip leaves uncovered.

bestPractices.description: Use showOn 'hover' for actions on media cards: it also reveals on keyboard focus within the container.
Put a focusable element (a link or the card title) before the overlay content in the container, so Tab reveals the content and the next Tab reaches it.
Use the Overlay component when you do not already have a container element to attach to.
Put the only way to reach an action behind hover with nothing focusable before it; keyboard users cannot focus content that is hidden.

docsDense.description: Overlay behavior on a container you already render (Card, media frame) w/o Overlay's wrapper. Spread containerRef + containerProps on it, render element / renderOverlay(children) once inside. CSS-driven via container :hover/:focus-within; hover mode also reveals on keyboard focus. Hidden content is not focusable, so put a focusable element before it, outside the area a revealed scrim covers (the scrim takes pointer input).

paramDescriptions.options.isOpen: controlled visibility; wins over showOn + touch toggle.

returnDescriptions.element: scrim with content, render once inside the container; null w/o content.
returnDescriptions.renderOverlay: (children) => scrim; for dynamic content or self-mounted scrim. Use it or element.

usage.description: Overlay behavior on an existing container: spread containerRef + containerProps, render element once inside. Scrim covers nearest positioned ancestor. CSS :hover/:focus-within; hover mode reveals on keyboard focus too. Put a focusable element before hidden content.

bestPractices.description: showOn 'hover' for media card actions; also reveals on keyboard focus.
Put a focusable element before the overlay content so Tab reveals it, next Tab reaches it.
Use Overlay when there is no container to attach to.
Hide the only route to an action behind hover with nothing focusable before it.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called when the page changes.

props.name: changeAction

props.description: Total number of items. Used to calculate page count. Takes precedence over totalPages if both provided.

props.name: totalPages
props.description: Total number of pages. Use when you know page count but not item count.

props.name: hasMore
props.description: Whether more pages exist after the current one. Use for cursor-based pagination where total is unknown.

props.name: pageSize
props.description: Number of items per page. Coerced to a positive integer; non-finite values fall back to the default.

props.name: pageSizeOptions
props.description: Available page size options. Shows a page size selector dropdown when provided.

props.name: onPageSizeChange
props.description: Called when the page size changes. Automatically resets to page 1.

props.name: variant
props.description: Visual variant controlling what appears between prev/next buttons. 'pages' shows page number buttons with ellipsis, 'count' shows 'X-Y of Z' text, 'compact' shows 'Page X of Y' (add first/last buttons with hasFirstLast), 'dots' shows dot indicators, 'input' shows an editable page-number box with a leading label ('Page [ n ] / N') flanked by first/last buttons by default (the box needs a known total to clamp against, so it is disabled in cursor/hasMore mode), 'none' shows just prev/next buttons.

props.name: pageLabel
props.description: The noun rendered before the editable box in the 'input' variant, e.g. 'Page' or 'Row'. Navigation is always page-based (via onChange); this only relabels the box. Defaults to the localized 'Page'.

props.name: hasFirstLast
props.description: Whether to show first/last («/») double-chevron buttons flanking prev/next. Applies to the 'input' variant (shown unless false) and the 'compact' variant (shown only when true); other variants ignore it. Omitted when the page count is unknown (cursor/hasMore pagination).

props.name: step
props.description: Number of pages the previous/next buttons advance per click. Clamped to the valid page range, so a step that would overshoot lands on the first/last page. When greater than 1, the buttons' accessible names reflect the stride. Non-integer or values < 1 fall back to 1.

props.name: siblingCount
props.description: Number of page buttons to show on each side of the current page. Only applies when variant='pages'.

usage.description: Pagination lets users step through pages of content. Place it below a table, list, or card grid so users can move forward and backward through results. Pick a variant to match the context: numbered pages for data tables, a count for large lists, compact for tight spaces, or dots for carousels.

bestPractices.description: Place pagination below the content it controls so users see results before navigating.
Use the pages variant for data tables where users need to jump to a specific page.
Use the count variant with a page size selector when users need to control how many items they see at once.
Use the dots variant for carousels and walkthroughs where the total is small and position matters more than a number.

components.name: Popover
components.description: A click-triggered popover for displaying interactive content anchored to a trigger element.

props.name: children
props.description: Trigger element. Must contain a <button> or [role="button"] element.

props.name: anchorRef
props.description: External ref to use as the popover anchor in sibling mode.

props.name: content
props.description: Content to display inside the popover.

props.name: placement
props.description: Position placement relative to the trigger. Logical: start/end resolve against the popover's own inherited direction, so RTL contexts mirror automatically in pure CSS.

props.name: alignment
props.description: Alignment along the placement axis. Logical: start/end follow the popover's own inherited direction (RTL mirrors).

props.name: isOpen
props.description: Whether the popover is shown in controlled mode.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Callback fired when the popover visibility changes.

props.name: isEnabled
props.description: When false, trigger interactions are ignored.

props.name: width
props.description: Width of the popover container. The layer still caps to the viewport with alignment-aware safe-area gutters before scrolling long content.

props.name: padding
props.description: Inner padding of the popover surface on the spacing scale (0, 0.5, 1, 1.5, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 8, 10), matching the padding prop on Card and Stack. Pass 0 for a flush surface when the content owns its own edges, such as a list of rows or a header with a rule, and pad the content itself. The padding sits on the painted popover target, so a theme padding on that target replaces it.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible label for the popover dialog. A sheet without one is named by the trigger’s text.

props.name: role
props.description: ARIA role for the popover wrapper. Use dialog for dialog-style popovers; use none when content provides its own role, like menu or listbox.

props.name: isModal
props.description: Whether a dialog-style popover sets aria-modal. Only applies when role is dialog.

props.name: hasCloseButton
props.description: Whether to include a hidden close button for accessibility.

props.name: closeButtonLabel
props.description: Label for the hidden close button.

props.name: hasAutoFocus
props.description: Whether to move focus into the popover when it opens. Focus enters the first genuine content control; dialogs with none fall back to the labeled surface. The generated fallback close control stays hidden until reached through keyboard navigation. Set to false for input-owned focus, inline showcases, or documentation previews.

props.name: hasLightDismiss
props.description: Whether clicking outside dismisses the popover. Set to false for surfaces that stay open until explicitly dismissed, like onboarding coachmarks.

props.name: hasEscapeDismiss
props.description: Whether pressing Escape dismisses the popover. Only takes full effect together with hasLightDismiss={false}, since native light dismiss also closes on Escape.

props.name: presentation
props.description: The surface that holds the content. 'popover' anchors it to the trigger, 'bottom-sheet' presents it in a modal BottomSheet labeled by label, and 'adaptive' uses the BottomSheet on a compact touch screen (a coarse pointer on a screen the theme counts as compact: narrower than its md width point or shorter than 500 px, so a phone in either orientation) and the anchored popover elsewhere. In a sheet, placement, alignment, width, role, isModal and hasAutoFocus do not apply, and xstyle, className and style style the sheet's panel; the sheet always light-dismisses (a tap outside it or a swipe down closes it, whatever hasLightDismiss says), Escape follows hasEscapeDismiss, and the fallback close stays hidden. The surface is chosen as it opens and kept until it closes.

props.name: xstyle
props.description: StyleX styles for layout customization (margins, positioning, sizing). Must be a stylex.create() value, not an inline style object like style={{}}.

examples.label: Flush surface for a list of rows
examples.code:
<Popover
  label="Recent files"
  padding={0}
  content={
    <List>
      <ListItem label="Quarterly report.pdf" />
      <ListItem label="Roadmap.key" />
    </List>
  }>
  <Button label="Recent" variant="secondary" />
</Popover>

examples.label: Roomier surface for a form
examples.code:
<Popover
  label="Save search"
  padding={4}
  content={<SaveSearchForm />}>
  <Button label="Save search" variant="secondary" />
</Popover>

usage.description: A click-triggered overlay anchored to a button or trigger element. Use it for secondary actions, inline confirmations, or supplementary information that does not warrant a full dialog. For hover previews use HoverCard, for brief helper text use Tooltip. Under a finger (a coarse primary pointer), it is presented like a native popover: it grows out of its trigger and shrinks back into it on the theme’s motion tokens; with reduced motion it cross-fades, opacity only, in 200 ms or less.

bestPractices.description: Keep popover content focused on a single task or piece of information.
Provide a clear way to close: either by clicking outside or with an explicit close button.
Theme the painted surface through the canonical popover target.
Nest popovers inside other popovers; it creates confusing focus and navigation.
Assume input complexity alone determines the presentation; evaluate the task's focus, space, and interaction requirements.
Assume scrolling alone means Popover is the wrong component; a bounded Popover may scroll while a focused anchored interaction remains appropriate.

components.description: 一个点击触发的弹出框，用于显示锚定到触发元素的交互式内容。

props.name: children
props.description: 触发元素。必须包含一个 <button> 或 [role="button"] 元素。

props.name: anchorRef
props.description: 在兄弟模式下用作弹出框锚点的外部 ref。

props.name: content
props.description: 在弹出框内显示的内容。

props.name: placement
props.description: 相对于触发器的位置放置方式。逻辑值：start/end 根据弹出层自身继承的方向解析，RTL 环境通过纯 CSS 自动镜像。

props.name: alignment
props.description: 沿放置轴的对齐方式。逻辑值：start/end 跟随弹出层自身继承的方向（RTL 镜像）。

props.name: isOpen
props.description: 在受控模式下弹出框是否显示。

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: 弹出框可见性变化时触发的回调。

props.name: isEnabled
props.description: 设为 false 时，忽略触发器交互。

props.name: width
props.description: 弹出框容器的宽度。弹出层仍会限制在视口和安全区域留白内，长内容再滚动。

props.name: padding
props.description: 弹出框表面的内边距，使用间距刻度（0、0.5、1、1.5、2、3、4、5、6、8、10），与 Card 和 Stack 的 padding 属性一致。当内容自行管理边缘（如行列表或带分隔线的标题）时传入 0 使表面无内边距，并由内容自行设置内边距。

props.name: label
props.description: 弹出框对话框的无障碍标签。没有标签的底部面板以触发器的文本命名。

props.name: role
props.description: 弹出框包装器的 ARIA 角色。对话框式弹出框使用 dialog；当内容提供自己的角色（如 menu 或 listbox）时使用 none。

props.name: isModal
props.description: 对话框式弹出框是否设置 aria-modal。仅在 role 为 dialog 时适用。

props.name: hasCloseButton
props.description: 是否包含用于无障碍访问的隐藏关闭按钮。

props.name: closeButtonLabel
props.description: 隐藏关闭按钮的标签。

props.name: hasAutoFocus
props.description: 弹出框打开时是否将焦点移入其中。优先聚焦调用方内容中的第一个控件；若对话框没有此类控件，则聚焦带标签的表面。生成的关闭按钮仅在键盘导航到达时显示。

props.name: hasLightDismiss
props.description: 点击外部是否关闭弹出框。需要显式关闭的界面（如新手引导提示）设为 false。

props.name: hasEscapeDismiss
props.description: 按 Escape 是否关闭弹出框。仅在 hasLightDismiss={false} 时生效，因为原生 light dismiss 行为同样响应 Escape。

props.name: presentation
props.description: 承载内容的界面。'popover' 锚定在触发器上，'bottom-sheet' 以模态 BottomSheet 呈现（由 label 命名），'adaptive' 在紧凑触屏（粗指针，且屏幕按主题定义为紧凑：宽度小于其 md 断点或高度小于 500 px，即任意方向的手机）上使用 BottomSheet，在其他设备上使用锚定的弹出框。在底部面板中，placement、alignment、width、role、isModal 和 hasAutoFocus 不生效，xstyle、className 和 style 作用于面板；底部面板始终支持轻触关闭（点按面板外部或向下轻扫即可关闭，不受 hasLightDismiss 影响），Escape 遵循 hasEscapeDismiss，后备关闭按钮保持隐藏。界面在打开时选定，并保持到关闭。

props.name: presentation
props.description: How the field presents filter editing. adaptive (the default) uses the bottom sheet on compact touch screens and the popover otherwise, resolved the same way Selector resolves it; the server render and the hydrating render are the popover. popover is the tokenizer field with its typeahead and the editor popover on every device. bottom-sheet makes the whole field, on every device, one trigger showing display-only filter tokens: it opens a Filters sheet listing the filters as rows that edit or remove a filter, with Add filter, Done, and Clear all (which asks first and keeps read-only filters); an Add filter sheet with the fields (or the content search with inline suggestions) opens above it, and a value step that stages operator → value and confirms from its footer opens above that. Dismissing a step reveals the one beneath. The flow edits a draft: adding, editing and removing filters and Clear all change the draft, and onChange is called when Done applies it, once per edit in order; dismissing the flow with a changed draft asks before discarding it. List values edit through the Tokenizer's own sheet. In the sheet presentation menuWidth and tokenOverflowBehavior have no surface to act on and warn in development. Pass presentation="popover" to keep the tokenizer field and the editor popover on every device.

usage.description: A horizontal bar showing the completion progress of a task. Use it for operations where the duration is known, or as an animated indicator when progress can't be calculated. Supports semantic color variants, value labels, and custom formatting. Under a finger a new value animates as on iOS: linearly, in proportion to how far it moves (a full track takes one second at the theme's default tempo), and the fill keeps a minimum visible length above zero.

usage.description: A horizontal bar showing the completion progress of a task. Use it for operations where the duration is known, or as an animated indicator when progress can't be calculated. Supports semantic color variants, value labels, and custom formatting. Under a finger a new value animates as on iOS: linearly, in proportion to how far it moves (a full track takes one second at the theme's default tempo), and the fill keeps a minimum visible length above zero.

bestPractices.description: Use a determinate bar when the total amount of work is known, and indeterminate when it's not.
Choose a color variant that matches the context: accent for general progress, success for completion, warning or error for alerts.
Always provide a label, even if hidden; screen readers need it to announce what's loading.
Place icons or labels inside the bar; compose them alongside it using layout components.
Use a progress bar for instant actions; it's meant for operations that take noticeable time.
Use multiple progress bars stacked together for the same operation; use one bar with a value label instead.
